Question: Alice and Bob play a game involving a circle whose circumference is divided by \(12\) equally-spaced points. The points are numbered clockwise, from \(1\) to \(12.\) Both start on point \(12.\) Alice moves clockwise and Bob, counterclockwise. In a turn of the game, Alice moves \(5\) points clockwise and Bob moves \(9\) points counterclockwise. The game ends when they stop on the same point. How many turns will this take?
